data.gender_notes: Fugere is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Biblical times, this name was given to those who had to escape from danger and carry away their loved ones or possessions. It is a reminder of God's protection and guidance in times of trouble. The name Fugere carries the meaning “To carry away, flee” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fugere usually hope their child will grow to embody to carry away, flee and live with faith, good character and purpose.
